rounding_convention: decimal.Decimal only, ROUND_HALF_UP per period/per figure. Dollar amounts quantized to $0.01 (all exact here); per-share amounts quantized to the nearest cent at presentation. Dilutive/antidilutive sequencing tested on unrounded EPS ratios. Bonds issued at par on Jan 1 and held all year, so simple full-year interest with no amortization.
